text:
Maya Chen: Hey folks — thinking about a Retro Arcade Night + Photo Booth + Travel Mug Swap next Fri (6–9pm). low-key, BYO mug (but bring a spare if you want to swap). :video_game: :camera_with_flash:
Andre Lopez: love this. count me in. can we do a 6:30 start? easier after calls. :raised_hands:
Priya Nair: i can DJ a little ska set between games if ppl want background music :) also can bring mocktail mixers (non-alc options) :tropical_drink:
Lena Gomez: vegetarian snack + gluten-free dips ok? i can pick up hummus + chips.
Maya Chen: @Andre 6:30 works. @Priya hell yes dj vibes. @Lena that'd be amazing, thanks. budget — thinking $8/head for snacks + printer film for polaroids. sounds reasonable?
Emily Park: i have a spare instax camera and extra film! can bring and run the makeshift photo booth. :polaroid:
Samir Patel: I’ll bring a roll-up extension cord and a powerstrip. also volunteering to manage the mug swap table.
Andre Lopez: quick sign-up (just add your name + any dietary restrictions): https://tinyurl.com/rw-infer-arcade-signup
Maya Chen: copy of what to bring in code-block for folks who want to reuse:
```
- travel mug (clean)
- spare mug for swap (optional)
- cash or venmo for snacks ($8 suggested)
- good vibes and pockets for quarters (jk)
```
Priya Nair: poll: bring boardgame or no? 1) arcade only 2) arcade + few boardgames 3) games in the park after (vote below)
Lena Gomez: 2
Andre Lopez: 1 (but fine with 2)
Emily Park: 2
Samir Patel: 3 if weather holds :sun_with_face:
Maya Chen: tally so far — leaning 2. will reserve lounge + move some tables for arcade stations.
DevBot: Calendar event created: "Retro Arcade Night — Lunch-plans" Fri 6:30PM — invite: #lunch-plans.
Maya Chen: volunteers: @Samir mug swap + setup, @Emily photo booth, @Priya music. anyone else want to help with teardown at 9:45?
Andre Lopez: I can stay 15 min to help pack up.
Lena Gomez: I’ll help with cleanup too.
Priya Nair: can someone grab battery-operated string lights from storage? they make it cozy.
Maya Chen: @Andre @Lena @Samir @Priya — amazing. i’ll post final checklist on Wed and order snacks Tues if numbers look good. thanks all! :party_popper:
Emily Park: yayyyy. can we have a vintage Mario high-score board? i’ll bring stickers.
Maya Chen: stickers approved. :smile:
Andre Lopez: :thumbsup:
